race.comment: The well-related ZWEIGELT (1) (half to G3 winner Band Of Brothers) is unlucky to still be a maiden hitting the top-five in all four starts to date and strikes a very winnable contest here. Gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim and should be ready to peak now third run back from a spell. Rates the testing material. INDAMOUSE (2) just ran into one better at Doomben last time out and looks to be working up to a maiden victory. Looms as the main danger. DUAL MASTERY (6) returned in good order with a close-up third in the same race and will have come on with that run now under the belt. Top-three candidate. LOTTERY LINK (3) has had a few chances but is usually thereabouts and may earn some minor money. PHOENIX LEGEND (5) best of the rest in an open race to kick off the card.
